verdict.rationale: ImageMagick's core interface is its official `magick` command-line tool. It is documented first-party, with command examples and a 'scripting-first design for mass batch jobs'. Community users independently confirm scripting it in bash and building one-liner pipelines. Missing for 10: agent-oriented CLI conveniences such as documented machine-readable output; the markdown version of the CLI docs returns 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: CLI & Automation Scripting-first design for mass batch jobs.
